name: bosun
description: Spec-anchored workflow for autonomous coding runs in Claude Code: brief, run, verify, checkpoint. Three provider modes: fable (Fable 5.1 in every role), fable-opus (Fable leads, an Opus 5.5 subagent implements) and opus (Opus 5.5 in every role). Verifier effort is independently selectable. Built from Anthropic's Fable 5.1 docs.
